n: Choiak, the fourth month of the Ancient Egyptian calendar, corresponding roughly to December

χοιράγχη.m: angina with external swellings like those in scrofula

Χολλείδης.m: a man of the deme Cholleidae

χολοειδής.m: like bile or gall, bilious; bilious, angry

χόνδρινος.m: made of groats or coarse meal

χονδρίον.m: a small rounded mass: lump; grain, groat, corn, spelt; cartilage

χοός.m: measure of capacity correspondent to 12 cotylae

χοραύλης.m: one who accompanies a chorus on the flute
